newsitem.title: INDIA: India Sept cement output slips to prov 4.89 mln t.
newsitem.headline: India Sept cement output slips to prov 4.89 mln t.

text.p: India's cement production fell sharply to a provisional 4.89 million tonnes in September from 5.72 million tonnes in August, the Cement Manufacturers' Association told Reuters.
September despatches dropped to a provisional 4.79 million tonnes from 5.5 million tonnes in August, a CMA official said.
In September 1995, cement production was at 4.77 million tonnes while despatches were at 4.79 million tonnes.
In the southern markets, rains have affected cement sales, an official of India Cements said. "We ourselves feel it (the impact)," he said.
Producers in other regions were not immediately available for comment.
An analyst at a leading British brokerage firm said September was traditionally a slack month for cement firms.

"The whole economy is slowing down a bit. Besides the growth rate for cement production in the first four months was quite strong and this seems to be a seasonal downturn due to the monsoons," the analyst said.
"It's a temporary phenomenon and production should pick up in the coming months," he said.
